architecture_decision: Do not alias complete SH-07 artifacts across paths. A future implementation must introduce an explicit immutable path-neutral semantic carrier spanning C2, C3, SH-05, SH-06, and SH-07, plus an independently authenticated per-path provenance and diagnostic envelope. Cache admission must bind exact source, plan, function, and policy identities; admit only successful products; enforce bounded single-flight; and fail closed for mutation, symlink, missing-file, failure, and concurrency cases.
